description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Gangulwitiya Gamage Hemantha Sudesh as a member of the Ratnapure M/C
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Ratnapura Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes, including the declaration of a new council member due to a vacancy caused by death, following procedures outlined in election laws. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate declarations, and election-related administrative matters.
